title: Desigualdad y desarrollo
goal: Read about Mexico's 1997 Progresa program -- a conditional cash transfer designed by Santiago Levy and rigorously evaluated -- as a response to inequality that outlasted decades of shifting development models.

items: Explain why inequality remained unresolved despite changing development models.
Describe what Progresa was and its conditions.
Explain what made Progresa's evaluation design unusual.
State what happened to Progresa after 1997.
Use por más que + subjunctive to introduce an emphatic concession.
